title: Replace the operating-block digest job's repo count with count-free wording
summary: Follow-up from opum-agent (orchestrator): OMARK-26 fixed the digest job's stale 'eight repos' to 'nine', but a live count in an instructional string goes stale again the moment a tenth repo joins -- precisely what happened to 'eight' this afternoon. quest-cli already carries the fix in its own operating-block job (prepublication-qualification.yml): count-free phrasing -- 'byte-identical across the fleet's repos by design... propagate to every fleet CLAUDE.md, then update EXPECTED_DIGEST in every fleet workflow.' Read directly from quest-cli's own working tree (read-only) rather than retyped from the message. Apply the same construction to opum-marketplace's ci.yml: the top comment block above the operating-block job and the job's own error message both currently name 'nine' and should not. No digest impact -- ci.yml is outside the hashed opum:fleet-operating block. CLAUDE.md's own historical line about opum-marketplace joining 'as the eighth repository' is unaffected and stays exactly as it is; this task touches only the live-instruction text in ci.yml.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every place ci.yml currently names a specific repo count in an instructional or explanatory sentence (not a historical record) uses count-free phrasing instead, matching quest-cli's construction.
The operating-block digest itself is unaffected -- ci.yml is outside the opum:fleet-operating hashed region, so EXPECTED_DIGEST does not change as part of this task.
CLAUDE.md's historical line about opum-marketplace joining as the eighth repository is not touched.

implementationNotes: Read quest-cli's exact wording directly from its own working tree (read-only: grep, no checkout/pull/stash/reset) rather than retyping from the orchestrator's message -- prepublication-qualification.yml already carries EXPECTED_DIGEST: 4cbdcba163ba318f and the count-free construction 'byte-identical across the fleet's repos by design... propagate to every fleet CLAUDE.md, then update EXPECTED_DIGEST in every fleet workflow.' Applied to both spots in this repo's ci.yml (the explanatory comment block and the job's own error string), plus one line of my own noting why: a repo count in an instructional string goes stale the moment the fleet's membership changes, which is what happened to 'eight' this afternoon. Verified: digest unchanged (4cbdcba163ba318f, ci.yml sits outside the hashed opum:fleet-operating block), check . manifests' diff scope empty (no skills/hooks/agents/commands/plugin.json touched), 46/46 hook tests still pass.
